name_reason: Compliant and accurate. fd2_ prefix (game fn); '_1e' is the dispatch-table index (slot 0x1E in the per-event handler table at 0x51B91), confirmed by xref math: the only xref to this fn is the DATA pointer at 0x51c09, and 0x51c09-0x51b91=0x78=30*4 -> index 30 = 0x1E; the value at 0x51c09 reads back 7a 4a 03 00 = 0x34a7a. The '1e' is a meaningful domain ID, not an address residue (fn address is 0x34a7a). '__unref' is correct: no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot; reachable only via the dispatch table (no callers). 'major_cinematic' fits the body (char spawn + dynamic turn-event scheduling + 2-page dialog + portrait swap). Naming is consistent with all sibling handlers in chevt1.c (e.g. _25__unref_major_cinematic).
purpose: Unreferenced (dispatch-only, slot 0x1E) major-cinematic chapter event handler: clears AI bytes for a char band, schedules two future turn events, spawns NPC/ally 萊汀 (char_id 6) at 1 HP, plays a 2-page dialog with a portrait swap, resets pending XP, and consumes tile-event slot 0x10 with value 2.
logic_summary: 1) for i in 0x0C..0x21 (22 slots): runtime_char[i].combat_aux_block[0xD]=0 (clear AI/sub-state byte). 2) Schedule two future turn events: *(tile_event_data_table+3)=(uint8)(turn_counter+1), *(tile_event_data_table+6)=(uint8)(turn_counter+2) (trigger-turn byte of table entries +3 and +6, 3-byte stride). 3) Configure runtime_char[0x0B] on the NPC/ally side: flags=0 (revive if dead), team=1 (npc), portrait_id=6, char_id=6 (=萊汀), combat_aux_block[0x0A]=0xFF, combat_aux_block[0x0D]=0x80 (AI byte, locked bit7), hp_current=1. 4) display_dialog_scene(page 2); load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1); display_dialog_scene(page 3). 5) pending_xp_credit=0. 6) tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10]=2 (distinct from the '1' written by other handlers). Single branch = the AI-clear loop; no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch slot argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91. The body never reads it (cast to void); kept for the uniform table calling convention.
params.reason: Accurate generic name matching every sibling handler's unread dispatch arg; no address residue, not param_N. Body ignores it, so a more specific name is not warranted.

comment_original_issue: The src comment described slot 0x0B spawn as 'as an enemy' while the code sets team=1, which is the NPC/ally side (types.h: team 0=enemy 1=npc 2=player; consts.h TEAM_NPC=1). The Ghidra plate already documented team=1 correctly as the ally side. Fixed the src wording to 'on the NPC/ally side (team=1)' and named the spawned character 萊汀 (char_id 6, portrait_id 6).
notes: team field semantics verified against src/include/types.h:24 (0=enemy 1=npc 2=player) and src/include/consts.h:49-51 (TEAM_ENEMY=0 TEAM_NPC=1 TEAM_PLAYER=2). portrait_id/char_id 6 -> 萊汀 verified via fd2-knowledge query.py portrait 06. Dispatch index 0x1E and the '__unref' claim verified: sole xref to fn is DATA at 0x51c09 (table entry, no callers); the 3 xrefs to table base 0x51b91 are the dispatchers (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction, fd2_fire_chapter_turn_events_for_phase, fd2_process_battle_drop_entries). No logic changes made. Ghidra plate left untouched (already consistent and more verbose; src is the precise SOT).
